name: Real leaders
about: Imran Khan as the jailed leader of chapter 1, with Sohail Afridi and Ali Amin Gandapur as playable characters, and the chapter's journey on real roads: from Peshawar by way of Charsadda and the M-1 motorway over the Indus to Islamabad. Their likenesses are built from video stills published by Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf under CC BY 3.0 (via Wikimedia Commons), adapted onto 3D heads.

heroes.name: Sohail Afridi
heroes.blurb: From the Shalobar tribe of Khyber district, the youngest chief minister in the province's history. Today he walks with the crowd to the jail gate.

heroes.name: Ali Amin Gandapur
heroes.blurb: The man from Dera Ismail Khan with the famous moustache. He has led long convoys out of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa before and knows how to keep a march moving.
